$comment: What the gates need from a machine. The repository declares capabilities and versions here; the paths themselves are supplied per machine and never tracked. Run scripts/bootstrap.ps1 to check this machine, or to write the local file the gates dot-source.

python.use: runs scripts/*.py and experiments/*.py; standard library only
python.hint: set METAFORM_PYTHON to the full path of a python.exe, or put python on PATH

leanProject.use: a Lake project whose environment can import Mathlib; check-paper.ps1 compiles proofs/QueryDriven.lean inside it. The program's gate does not need it
leanProject.hint: optional, and only for the paper gate: set METAFORM_LEAN_PROJECT to the full path of an existing Lake project with Mathlib built, on Lean 4.35

mathlibCache.use: where the Mathlib build cache lives, when it is not the default location
mathlibCache.hint: optional; set MATHLIB_CACHE_DIR only if the cache is not in its default place

notes: A version is a fact about the results, so it is declared here. A path is a fact about one machine, so it is not.
Anything that pins what the results are (Lean version, Mathlib revision, Rust toolchain, Cargo.lock) is tracked; anything that only says where it lives on this disk is generated.
scripts/bootstrap.ps1 starts from this file; it never invents a value it did not observe.
